demos.name: Shiny Text
demos.description: A band of light sweeps across the text, like light catching metal.

demos.name: Gradient Text
demos.description: Text filled with a flowing, seamlessly looping gradient. Optional animated border.

demos.name: Blur Text
demos.description: Words or letters come into focus from a blur, one after another. Click to replay.

demos.name: Split Text
demos.description: Letters (or words) rise into place one after another with a springy overshoot. Optional line mask for a pull-up reveal.

demos.name: Decrypted Text
demos.description: Characters scramble through random symbols, then lock into place one by one. Hover the lower lines to decode them again.

demos.name: Typewriter
demos.description: Types one or more strings, pauses, deletes and types the next, with a smoothly blinking cursor.

demos.name: Rotating Text
demos.description: Cycles through words with a per-letter staggered slide inside a pill that resizes to fit, or a blur flip.

demos.name: Count Up
demos.description: Numbers count to their target with easing, tabular digits, separators, decimals and prefixes. Changing the target animates from the current value.

demos.name: Sliding Number
demos.description: An odometer: each digit rolls vertically on a spring when the value changes, carrying past 9 like a real counter.

demos.name: Glitch Text
demos.description: Slices of the text jump sideways with red/cyan channel splits in short, violent bursts.

demos.name: Fuzzy Text
demos.description: Thin rows of the text jitter sideways every frame like a noisy signal; hover to crank up the fuzz.

demos.name: Circular Text
demos.description: Text set around a slowly rotating ring; hovering spins it faster.
demos.code:
ui.add(CircularText::new("GLOWKIT • ANIMATED • RUST • ").center_text("✦"));
ui.add(CircularText::new("hover to slow down * ").on_hover(HoverSpin::SlowDown));

demos.name: Scroll Velocity
demos.description: Huge rows of text marquee in opposite directions forever; scroll over them to kick the speed (scrolling up reverses).

demos.name: Wave Text
demos.description: Letters bob on a travelling sine wave, optionally with a gradient riding the crest.
demos.code:
ui.add(WaveText::new("Riding the wave").size(52.0));
ui.add(WaveText::new("with a gradient").colors(&theme.gradient));

demos.name: Proximity Text
demos.description: Letters near the pointer swell, thicken and shift color, nudging their neighbours aside.

demos.name: True Focus
demos.description: One word at a time snaps into focus inside animated corner brackets while the rest stay blurred.

demos.name: Sparkles Text
demos.description: Text with little four-pointed stars that pop in, twinkle and fade around it.

demos.name: Morphing Text
demos.description: Words melt into each other: the old one dissolves into a blur as the next condenses out of it.

demos.name: Text Generate
demos.description: A paragraph streams in word by word, each word fading out of a blur, like an AI response.
covers: Magic UI: Text Animate (blurIn by word)

demos.name: Highlight Text
demos.description: Animated emphasis drawn onto a phrase: marker swipe, underline, box, hand-drawn circle or strike-through.

demos.name: Colorful Text
demos.description: Each letter takes a color from a palette; every few seconds they reshuffle in a little blur-and-bounce wave.

demos.name: Gradual Spacing
demos.description: Letters start squeezed together and spread out to their natural spacing as they fade in.

demos.name: Text Roll
demos.description: Letters roll up and out while copies roll in from below, staggered. Holds while hovered; great for menus.

demos.name: Shuffle Text
demos.description: Each letter is a little slot-machine reel that spins through random letters and lands on the real one.

demos.name: Scroll Reveal
demos.description: A paragraph whose words brighten progressively from faint to full, driven by time, your own progress value or its scroll position.
demos.code:
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("When does a man die? ...").scroll_linked());
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("Driven by a slider").progress(progress));

demos.name: Line Shadow Text
demos.description: Bold text with an offset shadow made of diagonal stripes that keep sliding through it.

demos.name: Falling Text
demos.description: Click and the words drop under gravity, tumble, bounce and pile up; drag through the pile to shove them, click again to send them home.

demos.name: Animated Underline
demos.description: Link text whose underline draws in from the left on hover and slides out to the right when the pointer leaves.

demos.name: Scramble Hover
demos.description: Letters dissolve into flickering symbols while hovered and resolve back left to right when the pointer leaves.

demos.name: Box Reveal
demos.description: A solid box sweeps across each line and slides away, uncovering text that rises in behind it.
demos.code:
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("Magic UI.").size(64.0));
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("UI library for egui").delay(0.2).size(24.0));

demos.name: Curved Loop
demos.description: A text marquee flowing endlessly along a curved path. Drag it to scrub; throw it and it keeps running that way.
demos.code:
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Welcome to glowkit")
    .curve(80.0)
    .speed(80.0));
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Bend it like Rust")
    .curve(-40.0)
    .gradient(&palettes::MAGIC)
    .reverse(true));

demos.name: Text Cursor
demos.description: A trail of little text or emoji stamps pops out behind the pointer, wobbling and drifting as it fades. A ghost pointer draws loops when you are away.

demos.name: Scroll Float
demos.description: Letters float up out of the line, tall and squeezed at first, settling into shape one after another as the progress grows. Driven by time, a progress value or a scroll area.

demos.name: ASCII Text
demos.description: Big lettering redrawn as animated ASCII art: denser symbols where there is more ink, rippled by a flowing wave and tinted with a drifting gradient. The pointer bends it like a lens.

demos.name: Scrambled Text
demos.description: A paragraph whose letters dissolve into flickering symbols near the pointer and settle back into place after a moment.

demos.name: Comic Text
demos.description: Chunky comic-book lettering with a thick ink outline, a hard drop shadow and a halftone dot pattern, popping in with a springy twist.

demos.name: Video Text
demos.description: Huge letters that act as a window onto a moving scene (aurora, ocean, lava or plasma) flowing continuously across the whole word.

demos.name: Text Reveal Card
demos.description: Drag or hover across the card: left of a glowing divider, a hidden line of text shows through with twinkling stars.

demos.name: Text Hover Effect
demos.description: A huge outlined word; a radial gradient follows the pointer and lights the outline in color around it.

demos.name: Pointer Highlight
demos.description: A rectangle draws itself around a phrase while a pointer cursor glides to its corner, as if someone just highlighted it.
demos.code: ui.add(PointerHighlight::new("The best way to grow is to ", "collaborate", "."));

demos.name: Cover
demos.description: Text in a box that turns into hyperspace on hover: streaking beams, sparkles, glowing corners and jittering text.

demos.name: Number Pop In
demos.description: Old digits sink away one by one; new ones rise from below, small and soft, overshoot the baseline and spring into place, staggered left to right.

demos.name: Number Subtle Change
demos.description: A counter that changes quietly: the old value drifts a few points away and blurs out as the new one drifts in, up for increases and down for decreases.

demos.name: Text States Swap
demos.description: A status line swaps its words with a tiny lift: the old text rises and blurs out, the new text rises into place from below.

demos.name: Texts Reveal
demos.description: Lines (or words) rise 12 points, un-blur and fade in on a long smooth curve, each a beat after the last; hiding is a quick fade.

demos.name: Spinning Counter
demos.description: Digits on little drums roll to the new value column by column, neighbours ghosting past; each lands with a pull-back and a springy snap past full size.

demos.name: Thinking States
demos.description: An AI status label with a soft highlight sweeping across muted text; each new state lifts the old words away and rises in.

demos.name: Reasoning Stream
demos.description: A card of agent reasoning that scrolls itself: every beat the text glides up a couple of lines on an ease-out, fading at the top and bottom, looping seamlessly.

demos.name: Streaming Text
demos.description: A reply streams in word by word, each word fading up out of a soft blur a beat after the last, with a caret riding the end.
demos.code:
// feed it the text so far; only new words animate
ui.add(StreamText::new(&reply).width(380.0));

demos.name: Flip Letters
demos.description: Letters that roll over like a split-flap as the pointer passes, rippling to their neighbours with a springy overshoot.

demos.name: Text Reel
demos.description: A vertical stream of words under a fixed label; scroll or drag to inject momentum, reverse it, and let it ease back to cruising.

demos.name: Ink Reveal
demos.description: Every word starts faint and inks in as the scroll reaches it, with a soft leading edge; accented words light up with a highlighter swept behind them.

demos.name: Petal Dissolve
demos.description: A word erodes into tumbling red and white petals, then time runs backwards and every petal flies home to rebuild it.

demos.name: Molten Text
demos.description: A headline filled with churning molten metal: domain-warped lava, bevelled letter edges and a heat glow.

demos.name: Chrome Text
demos.description: Liquid chrome lettering: a sky-horizon-ground environment reflected in bevelled type, rippling, with a sweeping glint.

demos.name: Grain Text
demos.description: A headline filled with a slow drifting gradient of light under real per-pixel film grain.

demos.name: Dither Text
demos.description: A headline printed in four inks through an ordered-dither screen, with a band of light sweeping across it.

demos.name: Aurora
demos.description: Flowing curtains of northern light that drift and shimmer, fading into the background.

demos.name: Particles
demos.description: Drifting particles with depth, optional constellation links and pointer repulsion.

demos.name: Squares Grid
demos.description: An endlessly scrolling grid; the hovered square fills in and fades as you move on.

demos.name: Dot Grid
demos.description: A field of dots that bulges away from the pointer and springs back with a wobble. Click for a shockwave.
covers: Aceternity UI: Grid and Dot Backgrounds

demos.name: Grid Pattern
demos.description: Thin grid lines with squares fading in and out at random, a hover highlight and an optional skew.
covers: Aceternity UI: Grid and Dot Backgrounds

demos.name: Retro Grid
demos.description: A perspective grid floor scrolling toward the viewer, fading at the horizon.

demos.name: Flickering Grid
demos.description: A grid of tiny squares each flickering to random opacities, like a quiet LED panel.

demos.name: Meteors
demos.description: Meteor streaks with glowing heads and fading tails falling diagonally at random speeds.

demos.name: Shooting Stars
demos.description: Twinkling stars with shooting stars streaking across every couple of seconds.

demos.name: Background Beams
demos.description: Faint curved paths sweeping across the area with pulses of colored light racing along them.

demos.name: Wavy Background
demos.description: Thick, blurred ribbons of color undulating like slow ocean waves.

demos.name: Waves
demos.description: Dozens of thin lines warped by flowing noise; the pointer drags them and they spring back.

demos.name: Threads
demos.description: Fine threads fanning out from a bundle into flowing, rippling strands that lean toward the pointer.

demos.name: Silk
demos.description: Smooth, undulating folds of shaded silk with soft specular highlights.

demos.name: Iridescence
demos.description: An oily, iridescent rainbow film that swirls and shifts; the pointer stirs it.

demos.name: Swirl
demos.description: Psychedelic paint swirling into a slowly spinning vortex with marbled bands.

demos.name: Liquid Metal
demos.description: Rippling liquid chrome with flowing reflections; the pointer sends ripples through it.

demos.name: Plasma
demos.description: Classic demoscene plasma: interfering sine fields mapped to a glowing, looping palette.

demos.name: Lightning
demos.description: A crackling bolt with a white-hot core, wide glow and flickering branches.

demos.name: Orb
demos.description: A glowing ring of colored light with a breathing edge that ripples and spins faster on hover.

demos.name: Warp Speed
demos.description: Hyperspace star streaks rushing toward the viewer. Press and hold to engage warp.

demos.name: Galaxy
demos.description: A slowly rotating spiral galaxy with a bright core and colorful arms. Stars scatter from the pointer.

demos.name: Letter Glitch
demos.description: A wall of monospace letters constantly glitching to new characters and colors, with a vignette.

demos.name: Matrix Rain
demos.description: Columns of glyphs raining down with bright heads and fading trails.

demos.name: Ripple
demos.description: Concentric circles breathing in a staggered wave, fading toward the bottom.

demos.name: Spotlight
demos.description: Volumetric light rays fanning down from above, swaying and shimmering, leaning toward the pointer.

demos.name: Lamp
demos.description: A bright bar of light widening into view and casting a fan of colored light upward.

demos.name: Vortex
demos.description: Hundreds of glowing particles swirling into a vortex with short colorful trails.

demos.name: Gradient Blobs
demos.description: Big soft blobs of color drifting and blending like a lava lamp, one following the pointer.

demos.name: Mesh Gradient
demos.description: A smoothly animated four-color mesh gradient with organic swirl and distortion.

demos.name: Snowfall
demos.description: Gently falling snow with depth: distant flakes small and slow, near ones big and swaying.

demos.name: Grain Noise
demos.description: Animated film grain overlay that gives gradients an analog texture (right half).

demos.name: Background Boxes
demos.description: A skewed isometric grid of boxes that light up in random colors under the pointer.

demos.name: Beams
demos.description: Tall columns of soft light with luminous texture flowing down them; rotate for a diagonal look.

demos.name: Hex Grid
demos.description: A honeycomb of hexagons with random pulses, a rolling wave of light and a pointer glow.

demos.name: Liquid Ether
demos.description: A real-time fluid simulation: moving the pointer stirs glowing eddies of color that curl, mix and slowly fade. A ghost pointer keeps it alive.

demos.name: Grid Scan
demos.description: A wireframe grid tunnel receding into the distance, swept by a glowing scan frame that lights up the lines it passes. The view leans toward the pointer.

demos.name: Prismatic Burst
demos.description: Rays of rainbow light bursting from the center, rotating, flickering and breathing, with shock rings rippling outward.

demos.name: Grid Motion
demos.description: A tilted wall of tiles whose rows slide in opposite directions as the pointer moves, each with its own lag, for a deep parallax feel.

demos.name: Laser Flow
demos.description: A laser beam falls from the top and splashes across a surface, wrapped in luminous fog that curls outward and up.

demos.name: Metallic Paint
demos.description: A shape or logo filled with flowing liquid metal: rippling chrome bands, a bevelled rim and a highlight that follows the pointer.

demos.name: Background Lines
demos.description: Long flowing curves sweep across the area, drawing themselves in, lingering and erasing again, each on its own rhythm and in its own color.

demos.name: Dotted Map
demos.description: A world map drawn as a grid of dots, with glowing arcs flying between cities one after another and markers rippling where they land.

demos.name: Meta Balls
demos.description: Organic blobs that merge and split like liquid, colored by the dominant blob; one follows the pointer.
demos.code:
ui.add(MetaBalls::new().count(9));
// behind other content: MetaBalls::new().paint_at(ui, rect, pointer_pos)

demos.name: Ball Pit
demos.description: Glossy balls with gravity, collisions and bounce; the pointer shoves them around and an invisible hand stirs them when idle.

demos.name: Ripple Grid
demos.description: Grid lines rippling with waves from the center and the pointer, crests lit in the accent color.

demos.name: Dark Veil
demos.description: A dark, slowly flowing veil of tinted light, like light through smoke.

demos.name: Color Bends
demos.description: Bands of vivid color that bend and flow, leaning toward the pointer.

demos.name: Gradient Blinds
demos.description: Venetian-blind slats of flowing gradient, each lit across its width, with a spotlight that follows the pointer.

demos.name: Pixel Blast / Dither
demos.description: Animated noise or waves quantized with a 4x4 Bayer ordered dither into pixels, dots or diamonds; ripples burst from the pointer.

demos.name: Faulty Terminal
demos.description: A glitchy green CRT: flickering glyphs under a brightness wave, scanlines, rolling interference and row glitches.

demos.name: Fluted Glass
demos.description: A picture behind reeded glass: each rib is its own lens holding a squeezed slice of the image, smeared into spikes, bending harder near the pointer.

demos.name: Halftone Logo
demos.description: A logo built from a rotated halftone dot screen with a wave of ink rolling through the dots.

demos.name: Warp Grid
demos.description: A fine grid that bends into a gravity well around a dark sphere under the pointer, glowing where it is pulled hardest.

demos.name: Tornado
demos.description: A strand vortex: hundreds of helical lines pinch into a waist and flare into a swirling floor, with motes and comets riding the funnel; the pointer parts the strands.

demos.name: Accretion Disc
demos.description: A black hole: thousands of particles orbit an occluding core along glowing log-spiral lanes, with faint polar jets. Drag to orbit the camera.

demos.name: Light Cables
demos.description: A bundle of glowing fibre cables rising from a wide fan, folding through one bend into a bright point, with light pulses running up them; the cables lean toward the pointer.

demos.name: Wire Terrain
demos.description: An endless flight down a wireframe valley toward a banded horizon sun, with hidden-line ridges; the pointer steers the camera.

demos.name: Ribbon Glow
demos.description: Layered ribbons of light sweep across the frame, twisting as they go and bending into a bright swirl around the pointer.

demos.name: Matrix Junction
demos.description: Glowing beams converge from every edge on a bright node that throws jittered lightning arcs toward the pointer.

demos.name: Cloud Sky
demos.description: An animated sky: cumulus clouds drift on two parallax layers under a cirrus veil, with a low sun glow; the pointer turns the wind. Dusk palette on dark themes.

demos.name: Still Sunset Meadow
demos.description: A ground-level voxel meadow at sunset: square sun, drifting block clouds, a blocky treeline and swaying cube grass and pixel flowers with a soft out-of-focus foreground.

demos.name: Glimmer Vale
demos.description: A night meadow of rolling hills made of twinkling peach-to-violet glitter under a periwinkle sky, with blooming crests and soft daisies drifting in the foreground.

demos.name: Shimmer Button
demos.description: A dark pill with a spark of light racing around its border and an inner glow that rises on hover.

demos.name: Shiny Button
demos.description: A subtle surface button whose label and border catch a band of light sweeping across.

demos.name: Rainbow Button
demos.description: A high-contrast button with a flowing rainbow border and a blurred rainbow glow pooled beneath it.

demos.name: Pulsating Button
demos.description: A solid call-to-action that sends soft rings of color pulsing outward like a heartbeat.

demos.name: Ripple Button
demos.description: Material-style ink ripples spread from wherever you click, clipped to the button's rounded shape.

demos.name: Interactive Hover Button
demos.description: A dot beside the label swells to fill the pill on hover while a new label and arrow slide in.
demos.code:
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Book a demo"));
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Hover me").hover_label("Let's go"));

demos.name: Moving Border
demos.description: A glowing blob of light endlessly orbits the button's thin border.

demos.name: Hover Border Gradient
demos.description: A highlight circles the pill's border; on hover the light spreads over the whole border in color.

demos.name: Star Border
demos.description: Two stars of light glide along the top and bottom edges in opposite directions.

demos.name: Magnetic Button
demos.description: The button is pulled toward the pointer as it approaches and springs back when it leaves.

demos.name: Glow Button
demos.description: A glossy gradient pill floating on a breathing pool of its own colored light; it lifts on hover.

demos.name: Neon Button
demos.description: An outlined neon tube with glowing text that occasionally flickers, and floods with light on hover.

demos.name: Liquid Fill Button
demos.description: Liquid with a wavy surface rises inside the outline on hover, flipping the label color as it passes.

demos.name: Stateful Button
demos.description: Idle, then a spinner while loading, then a drawn check mark on success, resizing smoothly between states.

demos.name: Animated Subscribe Button
demos.description: A toggle that slides between two labels, gaining a check mark and a new color when active.

demos.name: Copy Button
demos.description: Copies text to the clipboard; the copy icon morphs into a check mark, then back.
demos.code:
ui.add(CopyButton::new("cargo add glowkit"));
ui.add(CopyButton::new("npm i glowkit").label("Copy"));

demos.name: Particle Burst Button
demos.description: Click to burst confetti, sparkles and dots out of the button (hold to keep spraying).

demos.name: 3D Push Button
demos.description: A chunky key you physically push: it pops up on hover and sinks on press with a bouncy spring.

demos.name: Pixel Button
demos.description: A retro 8-bit button with stair-stepped corners, a chunky bevel and a pixel drop shadow.

demos.name: Gradient Outline Button
demos.description: A transparent button outlined by a rotating gradient that floods the button on hover.

demos.name: Arrow Slide Button
demos.description: On hover the label nudges aside and the arrow chip shoots its arrow out while a new one slides in.

demos.name: Glass Icons
demos.description: Frosted glass tiles floating over tilted, vividly colored backplates; hover swings the plate and lifts the glass.

demos.name: Script Copy Button
demos.description: An install command with package-manager tabs and a copy button whose clipboard morphs into a check with a 'Copied!' bubble.

demos.name: Animated Theme Toggler
demos.description: A sun that morphs into a crescent moon; switching sweeps a circular reveal of the new theme across the area.

demos.name: Unfurl
demos.description: A parchment button that levitates, tips into a rolled scroll and drops its bottom roller; the charter inks itself in line by line and a wax seal stamps it shut.

demos.name: Liquid Glass Button
demos.description: Glass pills that blur and bend what is behind them like a thick lens, with rim highlights chasing the pointer.

demos.name: Venom Button
demos.description: A glossy black goo button: liquid strands stretch out to wrap a cartoon glove cursor when it comes close, then snap back with a wobble when you pull away.

demos.name: Spider Button
demos.description: A glossy red pill with corner cobwebs that shoots sagging web lines at the pointer, splats a web on click and snaps back when you pull away.

demos.name: Velour Bolster
demos.description: A velvet pill button that inflates into a soft cushion under the pointer, with grazing-angle sheen; it jiggles as you move, dents when pressed and settles flat.

demos.name: Expanding Arrow Button
demos.description: A dark pill with a bright arrow block that swallows the button on hover, its dotted chevron turning into a marching train.

if ui.add(ExpandingArrowButton::new("Book a demo")).clicked() { /* go */ }
ui.add(ExpandingArrowButton::new("Get started").accent(egui::Color32::from_rgb(125, 211, 252)));

demos.name: Quote Deck
demos.description: A testimonial deck fanned across the width: the focused quote upright, the rest leaning away, shrinking and dimming.
demos.code:
let quotes = vec![Quote::new("Every detail was argued for.", "Mira Okafor", "Design lead", "Northwind"), /* ... */];
ui.add(QuoteDeck::new(&quotes).lean(1.0).autoplay(3.6));

demos.name: Story Deck
demos.description: Customer stories beside a deck of portrait cards you can throw; autoplay runs with a progress ring round the next button.
demos.code:
let stories = vec![Story::new("We shipped in half the time.", "Ana Ruiz", "CTO, Brightline", "2x", "faster releases"), /* ... */];
ui.add(StoryDeck::new(&stories).autoplay(5.0));

demos.name: Project Folder
demos.description: A folder with pastel pages peeking out: hover and they fan up on rippling springs, press and they slide out into a row as the frosted front sinks.

demos.name: Wallet Card
demos.description: A wallet card whose balance rolls like an odometer when it changes, folds into dots behind the eye toggle, and carries a gain or loss pill that flips with it.
demos.code:
let mut balance = 12_480.32;
ui.add(WalletCard::new(&mut balance).name("Main Wallet"));

demos.name: Click Spark
demos.description: Lines of light burst outward from every click. Wraps any area without stealing its clicks.

demos.name: Click Ripple
demos.description: Concentric rings ripple out from each click like a drop hitting water.

demos.name: Pointer Trail
demos.description: A glowing comet tail chases the pointer and shrinks away when it stops.

demos.name: Ribbons
demos.description: Silky ribbons chase the pointer on springs of different stiffness, weaving around each other.

demos.name: Pixel Trail
demos.description: Cells of an invisible grid light up under the pointer and fade out, leaving a pixelated trail.

demos.name: Card Trail
demos.description: Moving the pointer drops a trail of cards that pop in, tilt and shrink away (image trail).

demos.name: Blob Cursor
demos.description: Gooey blobs chase the pointer with growing lag and melt into each other like liquid.

demos.name: Smooth Cursor
demos.description: A custom cursor glides after the pointer on a spring, turning to face its direction of travel.

demos.name: Following Pointer
demos.description: A collaborator-style pointer with a name tag that trails the cursor over a card.
demos.code:
let card = ui.add(my_card).rect;
FollowingPointer::new("Ada Lovelace").color(hex("#0EA5E9")).show(ui, card);

demos.name: Crosshair
demos.description: Hairlines track the pointer across the area, with an intersection ring and live coordinates.

demos.name: Target Cursor
demos.description: Spinning corner brackets follow the pointer and snap around whatever target it hovers.

demos.name: Magnet
demos.description: Wraps any content and pulls it toward a nearby pointer, springing back when it leaves.

demos.name: Confetti
demos.description: Confetti bursts from a point, tumbles in 3D and flutters down. Fire it from code or on click.

demos.name: Fireworks
demos.description: Rockets streak up and burst into glowing, falling sparks. Click to launch your own.

demos.name: Sticker Peel
demos.description: A die-cut sticker you drag to peel: the corner folds back along a crease, showing its paper back and a curl shadow.

demos.name: Magnet Lines
demos.description: A grid of short lines that all swivel to point at the pointer, glowing in the accent color nearby.

demos.name: Shape Blur
demos.description: Soft, out-of-focus outlines that snap into crisp focus wherever the pointer gets close.

demos.name: Lens
demos.description: A magnifying glass over any painted scene: the content is re-painted larger inside a glassy circular lens.

demos.name: Mask Reveal
demos.description: A circular mask follows the pointer and reveals an alternate version of the content underneath; it swells on hover.

demos.name: Animated Tooltip
demos.description: Overlapping avatars; the hovered one lifts and a name tooltip pops above it, swinging with the pointer on a loose spring.
demos.code:
let team = [Person::new("Sarah Chen", "Product Designer", hex("#8B5CF6"), hex("#EC4899")), /* ... */];
ui.add(AnimatedTooltip::new(&team));

demos.name: Scratch To Reveal
demos.description: A shimmering foil you scratch away with the pointer; past 50% the rest dissolves and it reports `revealed`. Self-scratches when idle.

demos.name: Compare Slider
demos.description: Before / after comparison of two painted scenes with a draggable divider and grab handle; sweeps on its own when idle.

demos.name: Hover Image List
demos.description: Big project titles; hovering one summons a photo that trails the pointer on a spring, tilting as it moves and sliding to the next image.

demos.name: Ink Trail
demos.description: A surface the cursor paints into: a glowing trail that drifts on a slow noise current and fades, like an ember on dark themes and wet ink on light ones.

demos.name: Dither Lens
demos.description: A photograph that turns into an ordered-dither print inside a ragged, flickering zone that follows the pointer.

demos.name: Mosaic Trail
demos.description: A field of tiny greyscale thumbnails that swell and bloom into colour along the pointer's path, then shrink back to dots.

demos.name: Cursor Ring Field
demos.description: A field of scattered capsules lit by a soft ring trailing the pointer: capsules on the ring brighten, turn and get pushed outward, then drift back.

demos.name: Fluid Trail
demos.description: The pointer stirs a small real-time fluid simulation, leaving glowing, color-cycling dye that curls and fades behind it.

demos.name: Hover Image Reveal
demos.description: A list of large names; hovering a row floats an image window that follows the pointer on a spring, tilts with its speed and swaps image per row.

demos.name: Card Stack
demos.description: A deck of photos that fans out as you reach it: hover draws a card up, click flips it into the middle.

demos.name: ASCII Wake
demos.description: A cube drawn in ink dots; the pointer drags a wake of characters through it that cools back to dots, and a press sends a ring out.

demos.name: Wake Slider
demos.description: A range made of thin bars with no thumb; drag fast and the bars you sweep past spring up in a wake behind the hand.

demos.name: Folding Bill
demos.description: A banknote simulated as cloth: grab it, drag it and fold it over itself; plain or with an engraved print.

demos.name: Heat Map
demos.description: Gray dots that melt into a glowing heat map under your cursor; press for the next shape.

demos.name: Generate
demos.description: Press Generate and an image resolves under frosted glass, broad shapes first.

demos.name: Image Accordion
demos.description: Hover a photo strip and it opens wide while its neighbours give way around it.

demos.name: Magnetic Select
demos.description: Press an option and it swells into an iridescent orb as the rest are pushed out of its way.

demos.name: Checklist
demos.description: Tick a task and the box pops full, the check draws itself in and the words strike out.
demos.code:
let mut tasks = vec![TodoItem::new("Water the ferns"), TodoItem::new("Reply to Ana")];
ui.add(TaskChecklist::new(&mut tasks).bounce(50.0).corner(20.0).box_size(18.0));

demos.name: Liquid Toggle
demos.description: A switch whose droplet stretches as it slides across the track and snaps round at the end.
demos.code:
let mut on = false;
ui.add(LiquidToggle::new(&mut on).speed(50.0).stretch(36.0));

demos.name: Now Playing
demos.description: A now-playing bar that opens into a full player and folds back as one piece.

demos.name: Slosh Slider
demos.description: A slider whose fill has weight: drag fast and the liquid sloshes past the handle before settling.

demos.name: Stacked Bars
demos.description: A month of visits as stacked bars: run along them and one day is ringed while a tooltip glides beside it; Day / Week regrows the bars.

demos.name: Emoji Reactions
demos.description: Press the button and the message turns into a pill of emoji; pick one and it flies down to its chip as the count rolls up.

demos.name: Voice Note
demos.description: Hold to record a waveform, slide left to bin it, let go to play it back.

demos.name: Time Scrubber
demos.description: Drag the ruler to set a time; fling it and it coasts with momentum to the nearest step.

demos.name: Label Input
demos.description: A field whose label rests inside like a placeholder and lifts into the top edge, opening a notch in the outline, when you focus it.

demos.name: Step Player
demos.description: Press play and each step fills as a bar, then eases on to the next dot.

demos.name: Glass Bubble
demos.description: Drag a ball of glass over a picture: it magnifies the middle, bends the rim and splits the colours at the edge.

demos.name: Slide to Confirm
demos.description: Push the handle across; past the mark it takes over, finishes itself and turns into a check.

demos.name: Pull to Refresh
demos.description: Pull the card down and it stretches while a ring of dots fills in; let go past the line to refresh.

demos.name: Escape Button
demos.description: A button that slides away from your cursor a few times, and then gives up.

demos.name: Create Menu
demos.description: Press the pill and it pours open into the create menu it was all along, items rising in one by one.

demos.name: Slingshot
demos.description: Pull the ball back: the band stretches, locks and trembles at its limit; let go and it flies, bounces off the walls and comes home.

demos.name: Asset Swap
demos.description: Flip the arrow to reverse the swap on a bouncy spring; tap a coin to pick another asset.

demos.name: Like
demos.description: Press the heart: it pops with a burst while the count rolls up a digit.

demos.name: Eye Tracker
demos.description: Two eyes on a soft cube turn to follow your cursor around the block, and blink now and then.

demos.name: Todo Tower
demos.description: A to-do list stacked like bricks; tick one off and it slides out while the rest drop into the gap.
demos.code: ui.add(TodoTower::new(["Water the plants", "Ship the release", "Call the bank"]).gravity(0.5));

demos.name: Action Node
demos.description: An automation step card with its controls folded into the corner; hover and they fan out one by one.

demos.name: Assignees
demos.description: Assign people from a list and their faces stack up in the pill above it.

demos.name: Palette
demos.description: A set of colours that go together; press for a new palette and it washes across, swatch by swatch.

demos.name: Dragging Ball
demos.description: A ball you grab: it swells under the pointer, squeezes as you hold it and wobbles home when you let go.

demos.name: Notification Badge
demos.description: A count badge slides out of the bell's shoulder, swells past full size on a springy curve and sharpens; it ducks away quickly when cleared.

demos.name: Menu Dropdown
demos.description: A dropdown opens from its top edge, scaling up from 97% while fading in on a long smooth curve, and closes faster than it opened.

demos.name: Dropdown Menu Morph
demos.description: A round plus button stretches into the menu it opens on a springy curve; the plus spins away as the rows slide in, and closing tucks it back with a small nudge.

demos.name: Modal Open Close
demos.description: A dialog pops in from 96% while fading on a long smooth curve, and leaves in about half the time.
demos.code:
ui.add(PopModal::new(open)
    .title("Delete project?")
    .body("This removes the project and its files for everyone.")
    .actions("Cancel", "Delete"));

demos.name: Panel Reveal
demos.description: A panel rises out of a clipped edge below its trigger, sliding up from half its height while it sharpens and fades in.

demos.name: Icon Swap
demos.description: An icon button swaps icons in place: the old one shrinks to a quarter, blurs and fades while the new one grows out of the same spot.
demos.code:
ui.add(SwapIcon::new(&mut open, SwapIconPair::MenuClose));
ui.add(SwapIcon::new(&mut playing, SwapIconPair::PlayPause).duration(0.25));

demos.name: Success Check
demos.description: A green disc bobs up on a springy curve, spinning back from an angle as it sharpens out of a heavy blur, and its check draws itself a beat later.

demos.name: Avatar Group Hover
demos.description: Overlapping avatars lift toward the pointer: the hovered face rises and grows, its neighbours rise less and less, and they drop back with a quick springy bounce.

demos.name: Error State Shake
demos.description: On a failed submit the field shakes with decaying swings, its outline turns red and a message fades in, then both ease back to neutral.
demos.code: ui.add(ShakeField::new(&mut email).error("Please enter a valid email.").attempt(attempts));

demos.name: Input Clear With Dissolve
demos.description: Pressing clear dissolves the query: the characters drift down and break into dust from the button outward, a soft haze blooms and the placeholder fades back.

demos.name: Skeleton Loader And Reveal
demos.description: A skeleton row breathes while it waits, then the real avatar and text fade up out of a slight blur as the skeleton melts away.

demos.name: Tooltip Open Close
demos.description: One tooltip shared by a row of buttons: it fades and grows in after a short delay, then glides and resizes between neighbours instead of blinking.

demos.name: Toast Open Close
demos.description: A toast rises 16 points into place, growing from 97% and un-blurring on a long smooth curve; it leaves the way it came, a little quicker.

demos.name: Learn More Hover
demos.description: On hover the chevron leans forward: it nudges right while its arms splay open, optionally growing a shaft into an arrow.

demos.name: Banner Stacking
demos.description: New banners rise in at the front while the others step back, smaller, dimmer and softer, peeking out above; the stack fans out into a list on hover.

demos.name: Checkbox Check
demos.description: The box fills in quickly, then the tick draws itself end to end on a long smooth curve; unchecking erases it fast.

demos.name: Matrix Dot Loader
demos.description: Tiny 4 x 4 dot matrices that flash dot by dot in scan, twinkle, orbit and pulse patterns.

demos.name: Toggle
demos.description: A switch whose pill thumb double-bounces: it overshoots the far end, swings back a hair and settles while the track flips color instantly.

demos.name: Live Island
demos.description: A black pill at the top of the screen that springs open into a live activity card and stretches to show notices.

demos.name: Preview Menu
demos.description: Touch and hold a photo: the grid frosts over, the photo springs into a large preview and a menu unfolds; slide onto an action and let go.

demos.name: Reorder List
demos.description: Drag a row by its grip: it lifts with a shadow, follows the finger with rubber-banded ends, and the other rows spring out of its way.
demos.code:
let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Inbox", "12 messages"), TouchRow::new("Today", "")];
ui.add(ReorderList::new(&mut rows).bounce(40.0).lift(50.0));

demos.name: Swipe Actions
demos.description: Mail rows that slide to reveal Flag, Delete and Pin; over-drag rubber-bands, and a long swipe stretches Delete across the row and collapses it.
demos.code:
let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Maya Chen", "Dinner on Friday?")];
ui.add(SwipeActions::new(&mut rows).full_swipe(true).resistance(50.0));

demos.name: Selection List
demos.description: Tap Select: rows slide aside in a cascade for round checkboxes, a floating toolbar rises, and a sweep down the checkbox column selects a run.
demos.code:
let mut notes = vec![TouchRow::new("Groceries", "Milk, eggs, bread")];
ui.add(SelectionList::new(&mut notes).title("Notes").cascade(40.0));

demos.name: Search Reveal
demos.description: A search field tucked above a list: pull down and it unfolds, stop halfway and it snaps; the list flicks with momentum and rubber-bands at both ends.

demos.name: Swipe Image Viewer
demos.description: A photo grid that grows into a full-screen viewer: swipe to page with rubber-banded edges, double-tap to zoom, drag down to fling it home.

demos.name: Tear Ticket
demos.description: A train ticket whose stub tears off like paper: the perforation gives hole by hole, the corner peels, and a freed stub flutters away before a new one prints.

demos.name: Meniscus
demos.description: A drop of liquid glass that pulls free of its dock and melts into whatever it touches, refracting and colour-fringing the pool beneath; tap to frost it.
demos.code: ui.add(Meniscus::new("Lido, four o'clock", "Pool floor, lane four, clear glass"));

demos.name: Plush Tile
demos.description: An app-icon tile covered in thousands of short combed strands that carry a mark in the pile; the fur parts under the pointer and stirs in a breeze.

demos.name: Arc Picker
demos.description: Options sit on the rim of a big wheel, turned to follow the curve; roll it and the chosen one lights up between springy brackets.

demos.name: Wheel Picker
demos.description: An iOS-style drum picker: columns roll under the finger, rows tip away toward the rim and click into a raised middle band.

demos.name: Sortable Stack
demos.description: Grab a task by its grip: it lifts off the stack while the others glide out of its way, and settles into its new slot when dropped.
demos.code: ui.add(SortableStack::new(&mut tasks).heading("In the studio", "Make room for what matters."));

demos.name: Card Dealer
demos.description: A deck deals cards that arc into a fanned hand, flipping face up in flight; sort, shuffle and collect send every card gliding on its own springs.

demos.name: Bloom Menu
demos.description: A Create pill blooms into a grid of actions: its box morphs open, the label glides into the title, the plus turns into the close cross and tiles pop in.

demos.name: Expandable Action Bar
demos.description: An icon toolbar that ripples open into labelled actions with keyboard hints; badges ride along and one highlight glides between actions.

demos.name: Expandable Control
demos.description: Round icon buttons that spring open into labelled pills, and chips that grow a remove cross when picked.

demos.name: Morphing Search
demos.description: A frosted search bar floating over a gallery rises into a panel of recent searches when focused, rows sliding in under a gliding highlight.

demos.name: Bouncy Accordion
demos.description: Rows share one rounded block until one opens: it breaks away into its own card, gaps and corners springing around it as its text drops in with a bounce.

demos.name: Overflow Actions
demos.description: A pill of actions with a round more button: press it and the hidden actions slide out one by one as the pill stretches and the dots fold into a cross.

demos.name: Swipeable List
demos.description: Swipe a row left to slide it over snooze and delete; fling it and it flies off while the rows below spring up to close the gap.

demos.name: Dock
demos.description: A macOS-style dock: icons magnify around the pointer, show a label and bounce when clicked.

demos.name: Marquee
demos.description: Infinite scrolling strips of any content with faded edges; hover to pause, reverse for variety.

demos.name: Animated List
demos.description: Items pop in one after another, newest on top, pushing older ones down: a live notification feed.

demos.name: Stack
demos.description: A draggable card stack: fling the top card away and it tucks itself in at the back.

demos.name: Card Swap
demos.description: A skewed 3D stack that cycles: the front card drops away and reappears at the back.

demos.name: Bounce Cards
demos.description: A fan of cards bounces in one by one; hovering straightens a card and pushes its neighbors aside.

demos.name: Carousel
demos.description: Drag or swipe between items that snap into place on a spring; neighbors peek in and dots track position.

demos.name: Ring Carousel
demos.description: Cards on a rotating 3D ring with real perspective. Drag to spin; it coasts and drifts when idle.

demos.name: Folder
demos.description: A folder that opens on click: the flap tilts down, papers fan out and lean toward the pointer.

demos.name: Elastic Slider
demos.description: Drag past either end and the track stretches like rubber, then snaps back with a wobble.

demos.name: Stepper
demos.description: A multi-step flow with animated indicators, sliding step content and a height that springs to fit.

demos.name: Animated Tabs
demos.description: A highlight springs between tabs, stretching as it travels; a softer hover highlight follows the pointer.

demos.name: Expandable Card
demos.description: Compact cards grow in place into a detail panel over a dimmed backdrop, and shrink back on close.

demos.name: Flowing Menu
demos.description: Hovering a row floods it with a contrasting band, entering from the pointer's side, carrying a marquee.

demos.name: Gooey Nav
demos.description: The active pill slides to the clicked item while colorful particles burst out and melt back in.

demos.name: Orbiting Circles
demos.description: Icons circle a center on concentric rings, each ring with its own speed and direction.

demos.name: Animated Beam
demos.description: Glowing gradient pulses travel along curved paths between nodes: data flowing through a system.

demos.name: Infinite Scroll
demos.description: An endless, wrapping vertical list: scroll or drag with inertia, or let it drift. Edges fade out.

demos.name: Masonry
demos.description: A masonry grid whose tiles glide to their new places on springs whenever the layout changes.

demos.name: Presence & Transitions
demos.description: Animate content in and out on a spring (fade, slide, scale, pop), and switch panels with transitions.

demos.name: Animated Content
demos.description: Wrap anything and it slides, scales and fades into place as it scrolls into view.

demos.name: Fade Content
demos.description: Content starts soft, ghosted and transparent, then sharpens into focus when it scrolls into view.

demos.name: Scroll Stack
demos.description: Cards pin near the top as you scroll and pile into a stack, each one shrinking back under the next.

demos.name: Gradual Blur
demos.description: A progressive blur at the edge of a scroller: content softens and fades in steps as it leaves.

demos.name: Apple Cards Carousel
demos.description: Tall full-bleed image cards in a scrolling row; clicking one morphs it into a large detail dialog.

demos.name: Container Scroll
demos.description: A device mockup tilted back like an opening laptop lid rotates flat as it scrolls into view.

demos.name: Hero Parallax
demos.description: Rows of product tiles start tilted and faded in 3D, then rotate flat and slide in opposite directions as you scroll.
demos.code:
let products: Vec<_> = names.iter().map(|n| ParallaxProduct::new(*n)).collect();
ui.add(HeroParallax::new(&products).title("The Ultimate\ndevelopment studio"));

demos.name: Images Slider
demos.description: Full-bleed slides cross-fade with a zoom-in entrance and a slow Ken Burns push, under a headline and call to action.
demos.code:
ui.add(
    ImagesSlider::new()
        .textures(&slides)
        .interval(4.0)
        .title("The hero section slideshow\nnobody asked for")
        .action("Join now"),
);

demos.name: Sticky Scroll Reveal
demos.description: Text sections scroll past a sticky panel that swaps its content and tints the backdrop for each one.

demos.name: Pixel Image
demos.description: An image resolves from a few big pixels to full detail: tiles pop in, then the mosaic sharpens step by step.

demos.name: Gemini Effect
demos.description: Five flowing colored curves draw themselves in, converging on a central pill and fanning out again. Bind progress to scroll.

demos.name: Tracing Beam
demos.description: A gradient beam beside the content that fills as you scroll, with a glowing head on a spring and a dot that lights up. Scrolls itself when idle.

demos.name: Icon Cloud
demos.description: A sphere of icon tiles rotating in 3D, scaled and faded by depth. It drifts toward the pointer; drag to fling it.

demos.name: Card Resize
demos.description: A card glides between two sizes on a long smooth curve, its skeleton bars and wrapped text reflowing live as it moves.

demos.name: Page Side By Side
demos.description: A two-page card: picking a token drifts the list left and blurs it out while the amount page drifts in from the right, and the card eases to its new height.

demos.name: Draggable Marquee
demos.description: A looping strip of portrait images that cruises on its own; grab it, fling it, and it coasts on momentum with cards leaning into the speed.

demos.name: Parallax Slider
demos.description: An endless strip of tall frames: drag, flick or scroll and each picture drifts against the motion inside its frame; titles rise on hover once still.

demos.name: Lens Gallery
demos.description: An endless wall of photos seen through a fisheye: drag and fling to pan while every tile bows through the barrel lens.

demos.name: Clothes Line
demos.description: Pictures pegged to a sagging rope that drifts past; every card is a pendulum, so they swing and settle as the line speeds up or stops.

demos.name: Aperture Zoom
demos.description: A hero that starts as a small rounded window onto an image and opens like a camera aperture as you scroll, the headline's words sliding apart.

demos.name: Zoom Reveal
demos.description: A small pill of footage between two words opens into a full-bleed frame as the page scrolls, the words riding its edges out and a play label surfacing.

demos.name: Marble Scroll
demos.description: A scroll story of full-bleed pictures whose seams tear and melt into marbling as they cross the view, strongest when scrolling fast.

demos.name: Step Path
demos.description: Process steps joined by one dashed line hopping dot to dot; it draws in on scroll, steps fading up as it arrives, then a darker stretch travels along it.

demos.name: Gallery Tunnel
demos.description: An endless flight through a square wireframe tunnel lined with images and bold color panels; click or hold to accelerate, the pointer steers the view.

demos.name: Spiral Images
demos.description: Image cards flow along an Archimedean spiral from the edge into the center, shrinking and turning as they are drawn into the vortex; hover to slow it.

demos.name: Coverflow Gallery
demos.description: A 3D coverflow carousel: the active slide faces you, neighbours swing back in perspective with a floor reflection; autoplays, drag or click to move.

demos.name: Spring Playground
demos.description: Tune stiffness, damping and mass and watch a ball spring after the pointer (or a hopping target), with its step response plotted live.
demos.code:
let pos: Pos2 = animate(ui, id, target, Transition::spring(stiffness, damping).mass(mass));
// any Animatable works: f32, Vec2, Pos2, Rect, Color32, Props, or your own type

demos.name: Easing Visualizer
demos.description: Every classic easing curve plotted with a dot riding along it, so you can feel the difference.
demos.code:
let x = animate(ui, id, target, Transition::tween(0.6).ease(Easing::OutBack));
let k = Easing::InOutCubic.apply(progress);

demos.name: Keyframes
demos.description: Values passing through several stops with per-segment easing, infinite repeats, yoyo vs mirror, and repeat delays.

demos.name: Timeline
demos.description: A GSAP-style timeline: tweens sequenced with relative positions, labels and overlaps; play, pause, reverse, change speed or scrub.

demos.name: Motion Box
demos.description: A container like motion.div: enter from initial props, hover and tap states, and spring to new targets. Its children stay fully interactive.

demos.name: Variants & Stagger
demos.description: Switch one variant name and every child follows, staggered one after another (from the first, or from the center outward).

demos.name: Presence
demos.description: Content that animates out before it disappears: auto-dismissing toasts and a keyed list where items enter, exit and the rest slide into place.
demos.code:
Presence::new(id, visible)
    .initial(Props::new().opacity(0.0).y(-12.0))
    .exit(Props::new().opacity(0.0).x(40.0))
    .show(ui, |ui| ui.label("Saved!"));

PresenceList::new(id)
    .initial(Props::new().opacity(0.0).x(-30.0))
    .exit(Props::new().opacity(0.0).scale(0.8))
    .show(ui, &items, |item| item.id, |ui, item| { ui.label(&item.name); });

demos.name: Layout Animation
demos.description: Items glide between layouts (grid ↔ list, shuffle) instead of jumping: FLIP-style layout animation keyed by identity.

demos.name: Shared Element
demos.description: A thumbnail expands into a detail view and back: the same key used in two places animates between them (layoutId).

demos.description: Grouped page tree, an article with breadcrumbs, callouts and code, a scroll-synced table of contents, prev / next cards and a helpful-or-not prompt.

demos.name: Pause Menu

demos.name: Health & Mana Bars
demos.description: Health, mana and stamina bars in three skins: damage cuts the fill and leaves a delayed trail that drains after a beat (with sparks and shake), heals pour in with a green ghost and rising pluses, low health pulses red.

demos.name: Boss Bar
demos.description: A wide boss health bar with the name glowing above, phase notches that fire a flash, ring and sparks when crossed, an armor layer and an enraged pulse in the final phase.

demos.name: Minimap
demos.description: Round and square minimaps with procedural terrain, fog of war that clears along the explored trail, a player arrow with view cone, pulsing enemies, rippling pings and objectives pinned to the rim.

demos.name: Ammo Counter
demos.description: Magazine and reserve counters: each shot kicks the number and ejects a spinning casing, low ammo pulses amber, an empty magazine flashes RELOAD and the reload sweeps rounds back in.

demos.name: Cooldown Icons
demos.description: Ability slots with a radial cooldown sweep, a bright hand on the edge and seconds left; coming off cooldown flashes white, pops on a spring and throws a ring of sparks.

demos.name: Hotbar
demos.description: Item hotbars where the selected slot springs up and grows with a glow beneath, its name popping up above; select by click, scroll wheel or number keys.

demos.name: Inventory Grid
demos.description: Drag-and-drop inventory: items glow by rarity (legendaries run a light beam around their slot), lift out with a lagging tilt, swap with a springy landing, and show a tooltip card comparing stats with your equipped gear.

demos.name: Item Tooltip
demos.description: Item tooltip cards with a rarity-tinted header, stats compared to the equipped item (green and red arrows with deltas) and flavor text, in all three skins.

demos.name: Skill Tree
demos.description: A skill tree where unlocking sends a surge of energy down the link before the node pops, rings and sparkles alight; available links shimmer, locked ones stay faint, and hovering shows a card.

demos.name: Quest Log
demos.description: A quest journal: main and side quests on the left with a gliding highlight, the selected quest's story, objectives with filling progress bars and rewards on the right.

demos.name: Loot Popup
demos.description: A loot reveal: an orb in the rarity color charges and trembles, then bursts into a flash, shock rings, particles and god rays as the item card springs out with its stats.

demos.name: Achievement Toast
demos.description: Achievement toasts that drop in on a spring, pop their badge with a ring and sparks, sweep a sheen across the card and count down before sliding away.

demos.name: Damage Numbers
demos.description: Floating combat text over a training target: normal hits pop and arc away, crits slam in golden with a starburst and shake, heals rise green, misses slide off. Click the scene to land crits.

demos.name: Crosshairs
demos.description: A set of dynamic crosshairs (cross, dot, circle, chevron, brackets, scope) that open on a spring as spread grows, with white hit markers and red kill markers.

demos.name: Loading Screen
demos.description: A loading screen with drifting level art, the level name in the corner, rotating gameplay tips, a progress bar with a moving sheen, a styled spinner and a pulsing prompt at 100%.

demos.name: Level Up Screen
demos.description: A level-up moment: rays wheel open, LEVEL UP slams in letter by letter with a shake, the level number rolls over, confetti bursts and stat gains pop in one by one.

demos.name: Kill Feed
demos.description: A kill feed where new kills punch in from the right with a flash, old ones fade and the rest glide up; headshots get a skull and your own kills a bright frame.

demos.name: Scoreboard
demos.description: A two-team scoreboard: rows stagger in, re-sort with springy moves as scores change (the new score pops), the local player glows, dead players dim with a skull and ping shows as signal bars.

demos.name: Character Select
demos.description: A hero select carousel: cards ride a spring along an arc with the chosen one tall and glowing, the scene tints to the hero's color, stat bars refill and the confirm button breathes.
